title: Entelechy
html_source:
Entelechy is the Aristotelian fulfilment of potential and the actuality of a thing made from it’s constituents. It can be applied to many aspects of philosophy and science.

So Stephen’s molecules may change but his self is continuous. Stephen associates this essence of him with memory and sums the argument up in the continuous I,I and the discontinuous view of the self I.I.
